Our client provides practical solutions related to Data and AI, Cloud Services, Robotics and digital Engineering and Business Process Management to their clients.
 ROLE
 Our client is seeking a SAP FI/CO Application Support Specialist to support finance-related enterprise applications and contribute to the maintenance and continuous improvement of SAP financial systems.
The ideal candidate will combine knowledge of SAP FI/CO with an understanding of financial business processes and their integration with other enterprise applications. The position is also open to recent graduates with strong technical aptitude, Python skills, and excellent communication abilities.
 Responsibilities
Support the operation and maintenance of SAP financial applications.
Assist with identifying, analysing, and resolving application-related issues.
Collaborate with Finance and IT teams to understand business processes and system requirements.
Support integration between SAP FI/CO and upstream or downstream business applications.
Participate in application testing, troubleshooting, and improvement activities.
Assist in analysing financial data flows and system dependencies.
Document incidents, functional requirements, and proposed solutions.
Contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of financial IT processes.
 Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Familiarity with SAP FI/CO functionalities.
Understanding of financial and accounting business processes.
Knowledge of integration between finance applications and related enterprise systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication and stakeholder coordination abilities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new enterprise technologies.
Fluent English, written and spoken.
 PREFFERED QUALIFICATION
Knowledge of SAP BPC, Sabrix, Ariba, BRIM, or ABAP.
Python programming skills.
Experience supporting finance-related enterprise applications.
Understanding of financial systems integration.
Chinese language skills.
